readingMode: Direct sequential reading of all 17 measures on both pages.

coverage.authoredAnalysis: Full first page read, measures 1-9: anti-corruption/tax-fraud and broad freedom goals; constitutionally protected public pensions; repeal 2012 labour reform with higher dismissal compensation but no amount; return health/education/justice/security powers to the State; universal public health/education and housing-access social protection; extend minimum-income benefit to families earning below 36,000 euros gross annually; reduce political privileges; broad authority/security goal without a specified policing instrument.

Full second page read, measures 10-17: combat migrant trafficking while protecting rights and safe orderly regular migration; regulate surrogacy protecting all parties; regulate voluntarily exercised prostitution with labour/security rights; protect investigative journalists; State pact against gender violence, inclusive feminism, tax benefits/exemptions for self-employed/businesses tied to net job creation; territorial integrity. No annexes, footnotes or further pages.
